# MemristiveIntegration

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-13

## Definition
Integration of memristor devices into wafer-scale systems for analog in-memory computing and synaptic emulation. Provides non-volatile, low-power synaptic weights crucial for scalable neuromorphic networks.
